0.2.0.summary: Added structured schema, anti-patterns JSON, per-tool format generation

0.1.1.summary: Initial AI context with full-context.md, cursor/claude/windsurf/copilot formats

Accordion.description: Vertically stacked collapsible sections. Compose with AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent.
Accordion.import: import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent } from "@usevyre/react"

antiPatterns.reason: Accordion requires AccordionItem as direct child
antiPatterns.fix: Always compose: Accordion > AccordionItem > AccordionTrigger + AccordionContent

Alert.description: Inline feedback message for info, success, warning, or danger states.

title.description: Bold heading text inside the alert

onClose.description: If provided, renders a close (×) button

antiPatterns.reason: No 'error' variant exists
Alert uses severity variants, not brand variants

examples.code:
<Alert variant="warning" title="Heads up" onClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  This action cannot be undone.
</Alert>
<Alert variant="success" title="Saved!">Your changes have been saved.</Alert>

Avatar.description: User profile image with fallback initials or icon.

src.description: Image URL. Falls back to `fallback` if not provided or fails to load.

fallback.description: Text or initials shown when image is absent

antiPatterns.reason: Minimum size is 'sm'
Maximum size is 'xl'

examples.description: Avatar with image and online status

Badge.description: Small label for status, category, or count. Use dot prop for live status indicator.

dot.description: Shows a pulsing status indicator dot

antiPatterns.reason: Badge has no 'primary' variant
No 'error' variant exists
No 'info' variant on Badge (use Alert for info messages)

Breadcrumb.description: Navigation trail showing current page location in hierarchy.
Breadcrumb.import: import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbSeparator } from "@usevyre/react"

antiPatterns.reason: Use BreadcrumbLink for correct styling and accessibility
antiPatterns.fix: Use BreadcrumbItem > BreadcrumbLink for each crumb

Button.description: Triggers actions and navigation. The most commonly used interactive element.

variant.description: Visual style. primary=high contrast CTA, secondary=bordered, ghost=minimal, accent=amber brand, teal=secondary accent, danger=destructive

size.description: Size scale. Use 'icon' for square icon-only buttons

as.description: Render as different element (e.g. 'a' for link buttons)

notes: Always add aria-label when using size='icon' (no visible text)

antiPatterns.reason: No 'blue' variant exists
antiPatterns.fix: Use variant="accent" for brand amber, or variant="teal" for teal

antiPatterns.reason: Maximum size is 'lg'
No color prop exists on Button
No 'icon' prop for inserting icons
Icon-only buttons have no visible text — screen readers need aria-label

Calendar.description: Date picker calendar widget for selecting single dates or ranges.

onChange.description: Callback when a date is selected

antiPatterns.reason: Calendar handles date only, not time
antiPatterns.fix: Combine with a separate time Input if time selection is needed

Card.description: Content container with optional header, body, and footer sections.
Card.import: import { Card, CardHeader, CardBody, CardFooter } from "@usevyre/react"

clickable.description: Adds cursor pointer and active press feedback

antiPatterns.reason: Card has no 'primary' variant

examples.code:
New

Card Title

Description text.

Checkbox.description: Binary toggle for boolean form values.

indeterminate.description: Shows dash icon for partial selection state

antiPatterns.reason: Maximum size is 'md'

examples.code:
<label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--vyre-spacing-2)' }}>
  <Checkbox checked={agreed} onChange={e => setAgreed(e.target.checked)} />
  I agree to the terms
</label>

Command.description: Command palette / search dialog. Use for search-first navigation or quick actions.
Command.import: import { Command, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandDialog } from "@usevyre/react"

antiPatterns.pattern: Using Input type="search" for search UI
antiPatterns.reason: Command component is the correct pattern for search-first UI

examples.code:
<Command>
  <CommandInput placeholder="Search..." />
  <CommandList>
    <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
    <CommandGroup heading="Suggestions">
      <CommandItem onSelect={() => handleSelect('dashboard')}>Dashboard</CommandItem>
      <CommandItem onSelect={() => handleSelect('settings')}>Settings</CommandItem>
    </CommandGroup>
  </CommandList>
</Command>

DropdownMenu.description: Contextual menu triggered by a button. Supports items, separators, checkbox items, radio groups, and sub-menus.
DropdownMenu.import: import { DropdownMenu, DropdownItem, DropdownSeparator, DropdownCheckboxItem, DropdownRadioGroup, DropdownRadioItem, DropdownSub } from "@usevyre/react"

trigger.description: Element that opens the dropdown when clicked

antiPatterns.reason: DropdownItem only has 'default' and 'danger' variants
antiPatterns.fix: Use variant="danger" for destructive items only

examples.code:
<DropdownMenu trigger={<Button variant="secondary">Options</Button>}>
  <DropdownItem onSelect={() => handleEdit()}>Edit</DropdownItem>
  <DropdownItem onSelect={() => handleDuplicate()}>Duplicate</DropdownItem>
  <DropdownSeparator />
  <DropdownItem variant="danger" onSelect={() => handleDelete()}>Delete</DropdownItem>
</DropdownMenu>

Field.description: Form field wrapper providing label, hint text, and validation state for Input or Textarea.

hint.description: Helper or error text below the input

state.description: Validation state — affects border color and hint text color

antiPatterns.pattern: Applying state prop directly to Input
antiPatterns.reason: state belongs on Field, not on the Input itself
antiPatterns.fix: Wrap Input in <Field state="error"> to apply validation styling

examples.code:
<Field label="Email" state="error" hint="Invalid email format">
  <Input type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
</Field>

Input.description: Text input field. Wrap in Field for labels and validation. Use leftElement/rightElement for icons.

size.description: Height and text size scale. Note: 'icon' size is NOT valid for Input

leftElement.description: Icon or element rendered inside the input on the left

rightElement.description: Icon or element rendered inside the input on the right

antiPatterns.reason: 'icon' size is only valid for Button, not Input
Use Command component for search-first interfaces
antiPatterns.fix: Import Command from @usevyre/react for search palettes

Label.description: Accessible form label. Associate with input via htmlFor.

htmlFor.description: ID of the associated input element

Modal.description: Dialog overlay for confirmations, forms, or focused content.
Modal.import: import { Modal, ModalHeader, ModalBody, ModalFooter } from "@usevyre/react"

title.description: Accessible dialog title (also shown as heading)

antiPatterns.reason: Maximum size is 'full'

examples.code:
<Modal open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} title="Confirm Delete" size="sm">
  <ModalBody>Are you sure you want to delete this item?</ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter>
    <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button variant="danger" onClick={handleDelete}>Delete</Button>
  </ModalFooter>
</Modal>

Pagination.description: Page navigation for paginated lists or tables.

onChange.description: Called with new page number when user navigates

Popover.description: Floating content panel anchored to a trigger element. For simple labels use Tooltip instead.

antiPatterns.reason: No 'top-center' — center alignment is the default when no suffix is given

examples.code:
More info} placement="bottom-start">

Detailed information here.

Progress.description: Visual progress indicator for tasks, uploads, or completion status.

antiPatterns.reason: Value is clamped to 0–100
antiPatterns.fix: Normalize your value to 0–100 range before passing

Select.description: Dropdown for selecting one option from a list.

options.description: Array of { value: string, label: string } objects

onChange.description: Called with new value string on selection

placeholder.description: Placeholder text when no value is selected

antiPatterns.reason: Select uses options prop, not children

examples.code:
<Select
  options={[{ value: 'react', label: 'React' }, { value: 'vue', label: 'Vue' }]}
  value={framework}
  onChange={setFramework}
  placeholder="Choose framework"
/>

Sheet.description: Side panel (drawer) that slides in from the edge. For forms, detail views, or settings.
Sheet.import: import { Sheet, SheetHeader, SheetBody, SheetFooter } from "@usevyre/react"

side.description: Which edge the sheet slides from

examples.code:
<Sheet open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} title="Settings" side="right">
  <SheetBody>Settings content here.</SheetBody>
  <SheetFooter>
    <Button variant="accent">Save</Button>
  </SheetFooter>
</Sheet>

Sidebar.description: App navigation sidebar. Use AppLayout as the root layout wrapper.
Sidebar.import: import { AppLayout, Sidebar, SidebarHeader, SidebarContent, SidebarSection, SidebarItem, SidebarFooter } from "@usevyre/react"

examples.code:
<AppLayout>
  <Sidebar>
    <SidebarHeader>Logo</SidebarHeader>
    <SidebarContent>
      <SidebarSection heading="Main">
        <SidebarItem href="/" active>Dashboard</SidebarItem>
        <SidebarItem href="/settings">Settings</SidebarItem>
      </SidebarSection>
    </SidebarContent>
    <SidebarFooter><Avatar fallback="JD" size="sm" /></SidebarFooter>
  </Sidebar>
  <main>Page content</main>
</AppLayout>

Skeleton.description: Loading placeholder that mimics the shape of content while data loads.

variant.description: Shape of the skeleton. 'circle' for avatars, 'text' for text lines, 'rect' for blocks

Slider.description: Range input for selecting a numeric value within a range.

Switch.description: Toggle switch for boolean on/off settings.

examples.code:
<label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 'var(--vyre-spacing-2)' }}>
  <Switch checked={notifications} onChange={setNotifications} />
  Enable notifications
</label>

Table.description: Data table with optional sorting. Compose with TableHeader, TableRow, TableCell.
Table.import: import { Table, TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, TableHeader, TableCell } from "@usevyre/react"

Tabs.description: Tabbed navigation for switching between content panels.
Tabs.import: import { Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanels, TabPanel } from "@usevyre/react"

defaultIndex.description: Index of the initially active tab (uncontrolled)

onChange.description: Called with new index when tab changes

Toast.description: Transient notification. Use the useToast hook to trigger toasts imperatively. React: wrap app in <ToastProvider>. Vue: place <ToastViewport /> once in app root.
Toast.import: import { useToast, ToastProvider } from "@usevyre/react" // Vue: import { useToast, ToastViewport } from "@usevyre/vue"

variant.description: Color and icon of the toast

antiPatterns.reason: Toast is triggered via the useToast hook, not rendered directly
antiPatterns.fix: Use: const { toast } = useToast(); then toast({ title, variant })

antiPatterns.reason: No 'error' variant
No 'info' variant on Toast

examples.code:
const { toast } = useToast();

<Button onClick={() => toast({ title: 'Saved!', variant: 'success', duration: 3000 })}>
  Save
</Button>

Tooltip.description: Short label that appears on hover/focus. For rich content use Popover instead.

content.description: Text or element shown in the tooltip

delay.description: Delay in ms before tooltip appears

antiPatterns.pattern: Using Tooltip for rich content (forms, buttons, etc.)
antiPatterns.reason: Tooltip is for short text labels only
antiPatterns.fix: Use Popover for rich interactive content

examples.code:
<Tooltip content="Close dialog" placement="bottom">
  <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Close">
    <X size={16} />
  </Button>
</Tooltip>

Typography.description: Text rendering components with semantic scale. Includes Text, Heading, Lead, Code, Blockquote.
Typography.import: import { Text, Heading, Lead, Code, Blockquote } from "@usevyre/react"

antiPatterns.pattern:
Using raw

,

tags instead of Typography components
antiPatterns.reason: Typography components apply the correct token-based styles

examples.code:
<Heading size="2xl" as="h1">Dashboard</Heading>
<Lead>Welcome back. Here's what's happening today.</Lead>
<Text size="sm" style={{ color: 'var(--vyre-color-semantic-text-muted)' }}>Last updated 5 minutes ago.</Text>
